pos.personaBrief: Flamengo 2022 liked to dominate the ball and press the build-up (A Gazeta, Driblab), and the Santos 2010 side was attacking and open. Possession-minded, not a counter team.

pro.personaBrief: Simple, objective system with lots of movement and passing lines (Drible de Corpo), recovering quickly high up. Builds with the ball but is not obsessive about slow circulation.

est.personaBrief: The losango looked rigid but had constant rotations and position swaps; Santos 2010 had freedom of movement. Relational with a simple base structure.

lar.personaBrief: Flamengo used Marinho and Cebolinha as true wide wingers in a 4-3-3, while Santos 2010 had Robinho right and Neymar left; he later also used the losango.

blo.personaBrief: Flamengo pressed the opponent's build-up and recovered far more in the opposition half (Driblab, A Gazeta), with collective commitment to reducing space.

mar.personaBrief: No source states the marking scheme; the Brazilian-style compact 4-4-2 recomposition and space reduction suggest zonal defending as default.

pla.personaBrief: Does not invent, keeps a simple own model with the same base across games, but adapts to the squad and mid-season arrival; two teams (main and reserve) rather than opponent-specific plans.

res.personaBrief: Won Copa do Brasil and Libertadores with an attacking, ball-dominant team; plays to win, not to settle, while staying pragmatic and simple.

sis.personaBrief: Accommodated Neymar, Ganso, Robinho with freedom, but demanded collective recomposition (Gabigol, Everton Ribeiro doing defensive work) and benched Neymar in 2010.

jog.personaBrief: Santos 2010 and Flamengo 2022 were technical sides (Ganso, Arrascaeta, Everton Ribeiro) with high intensity in recovery, so both technique and intensity matter.

bas.personaBrief: Gave minutes to academy players like Victor Hugo and Neymar/Andre in 2010 under pressure, but won titles with a stacked Flamengo squad of experienced signings.

lid.personaBrief: Players thanked him publicly and he managed stars well at Flamengo, but at Santos he was fired after trying to bench Neymar for indiscipline, so rules apply to all.
